owned_directory: small_rna/ in existing microenvironment round3 worktree
question: Do direct mature microRNA measurements in authentic EMC support a previously unestablished coordinated DLK1-DIO3 regulatory-domain expression phenotype, beyond the known neuronal/neuroendocrine mRNA differentiation program?
premises_to_verify: Verify EMC differentiation and the biological relevance of the DLK1-DIO3 domain from primary studies before data values. This question is orthogonal to the concurrent DLK1 mRNA candidate, whose results have not been inspected by the lead. Co-expression cannot establish loss of imprinting, dependency or causal regulation.
gate: Search original sarcoma/EMC small-RNA studies, supplements, citation trails and public repositories, including historical aliases and every eligible EMC observation. If the same phenotype is established, no authenticated direct small-RNA measurement exists, or no useful added biological conclusion is possible, stop without gene or domain substitution. An inventory is only a feasibility gate, not a disease finding.
pilot_if_gate_passes: Record exact cluster membership from a primary/reference annotation source, sample identities, eligible EMC donors/conditions, comparator selection, normalization, uncertainty, operational decision thresholds and potential donor overlap before values. Use a single fixed cluster-level question; retain every eligible measured member, all adverse/inconclusive observations and the original hypothesis. Independent challenge required before advancement.
potential_value: A reproducible direct small-RNA phenotype could change which regulatory mechanism an EMC researcher tests next. It cannot establish that the locus is epigenetically deregulated or that targeting it is therapeutic.
defeaters: Prior art, mature-miRNA assay unsuitability, incomplete identity or cohort overlap, reference/normal-tissue or composition explanation, inconsistent cluster-wide effect, failed independent measurements, no practical experiment changed.
stop: One bounded source/value gate and conditional pilot, no classifier or endless target screening. Shelf if no useful contribution survives; retain pending accessible evidence and unavailable evidence honestly.
restrictions: Reuse installed dependencies and scoped data; no large download without headroom check. Daily America/New_York 06:00-10:00 no UI/browser/screenshots/headless; check time before each operation; Sept12 exception expired; quiet file/API work allowed. No supported browser available. No paid resources/outreach/external records/publication/PR/commit/push. Mandatory all-public EMC coverage and automatic scientific follow-through persist.
